links.outcome: Ambient scribe effects on documentation time, usability, clinician well-being, and satisfaction
links.effect: Active note time fell from 5.54 to 4.09 min per appointment (26.2% reduction; p<0.001); survey (n=233) reported reduced burnout, increased satisfaction and work-life balance. Documentation accuracy was not assessed.
links.quote: Compared with the preimplementation period, active note time decreased significantly (5.54-4.09 min per appointment; 26.2% reduction; p < 0.001).

links.outcome: Documentation time and clinician burnout measured after AI scribe deployment
links.effect: Active note time decreased 26.2%; survey at 45 days showed most respondents reported reduced burnout; note length rose 28.8%. Coding accuracy and intensity were not measured.
links.quote: Survey responses (n = 233; 26.4% response rate) indicated improvements across domains, with most respondents reporting reduced burnout, increased job satisfaction, improved work-life balance, and a strong preference to continue using DAX.

links.outcome: Clinician satisfaction, intent to remain, and work-life balance surveyed post-deployment
links.effect: Survey (n=233; 26.4% response rate) at 45 days post-activation showed improved satisfaction, work-life balance, and strong preference to continue using DAX.
links.quote: Survey responses (n = 233; 26.4% response rate) indicated improvements across domains, with most respondents reporting reduced burnout, increased job satisfaction, improved work-life balance, and a strong preference to continue using DAX.

unlisted_practices: Measuring note composition changes (typing, copy/paste, voice recognition share, note length) after ambient scribe deployment

screen.reason: Evaluates the real-world operational and well-being impact of deploying ambient AI documentation across a health system pre- vs post-implementation, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment variation.
